mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors rotate into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) above 3-month moving averages indicates robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days via revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: Joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS > 3mo MA) fails to predict positive returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (2017=100) during post-recession recovery signals strengthening manufacturing capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as profit margins stabilize.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of post-recession recovery periods with INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 3-month moving average signals labor market strength that supports consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with PAYEMS > 3mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% during early-cycle expansion indicates robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via earnings acceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of early-cycle expansion periods with GDPC1 > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100 during supply shock recovery signals manufacturing output normalization, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as margins improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of supply shock recovery periods with INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
